title: First game made - feedback wanted
author: KingofKingsofKingsof
selftext:
I released my first game on Itch - it's not completely finished, I want to add more levels, and I may rework existing levels based on feedback.  It works on phone or PC, touch, controller and keyboard support.  Also various colour-blind modes, as the game is all about mixing colours.  Artwork is by me, so I wanted a simple art style.

I made the base engine in Gamemaker, and ported it over to Javascript/HTML with Claude Opus 5.5, and finished it off with Claude Opus 5.5, levels made by hand with a level editor.

Any constructive feedback is appreciated.

[Fuzzy Fuzzpot by stuartking84](https://stuartking84.itch.io/fuzzy-fuzzpot)
